verdict.rationale: Hatchet claims built-in real-time monitoring and logging, and its CLI TUI offers real-time observability into tasks and workflows. Community users praise its 'decent built-in observability' and 'flow-based UI', and an OpenTelemetry integration page exists. However, nothing in the evidence shows a per-run, step-by-step timeline with inputs, outputs, retries and errors, or a dashboard the team can search and filter. Missing for 10: documented per-step input/output and error views in a run timeline, per-step retry history display, search and filter capability in the web dashboard, and hands-on corroboration of the run-detail UI.
